articles.title: Dallas’ Care.com Hires Former Amazon and Grubhub Exec as Chief Product and Technology Officer
articles.summary: Dallas-based Care.com just hired veteran chief product executive Sam Hall as its chief product and technology officer. He previously held product positions at Amazon, GrubHub and ClassPass. Hall “is going to help us create deeper, more lasting value for our customers whether you’re a family looking for care or a caregiver looking for work,” Care.com…

articles.title: Fleet Software Company Intangles Opens U.S. HQ in Irving
articles.summary: Intangles, a Pune, India-based company whose digital twin and AI software helps trucking fleet owners manage maintenance, just established its U.S. headquarters in Irving. The business employs 15 people in North Texas today and plans to grow the team to 100 people by the end of 2027. …

articles.title: Texas College Students Shy Away From AI-Exposed Majors, Dallas Fed Study Finds
articles.summary: For years, high school students and their parents thought majoring in computer science in college was a solid plan for a well-paying career. Now, Texas college students are turning away from it and other AI-exposed majors, new research from the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas finds.…
